overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Financials 2x Daily ETF (XLFX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to 2x the daily performance of the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR Fund. The fund provides leveraged exposure to U.S XLFX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
